details.eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university (as per the IBPS PO notification on ibps.in).
details.pattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes (English 30, Quant 35, Reasoning 35). Mains: 155 objective questions + descriptive English, 225 marks. Then Interview.
details.syllabus: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, English Language, General/Banking Awareness, Computer Knowledge, Data Analysis & Interpretation, Descriptive English (letter & essay).
